desc:
Hollow Pines has a ranger, a lodge, and a forest that people don't come back from. 🌲

Five are missing. Ranger Hollis needs proof of what took them, and he'll pay for every photo you bring back. 📸

Take his camera. Light your lantern. 🏮 Walk past the hedge.

Out there, things watch from the trees. 👀 Some only watch. Some follow you home. Some will run you down if your light goes out.

Photograph them. Sell what you find. Buy better gear and go deeper: the Deep Woods, the Black Bog, the corn maze at Harrow Field, where something walks above the treeline. 🌕

Every night is different. The lamp oil never lasts.

Get back before dark. 🕯️

***This is a BETA Release***
Please report any bugs/feedback in the mail slot next to the front door of the cabin. Thanks!
